svg.text: K5 fuel system: regulator, plumbing and fuel pressure sensing
1977 K5 Blazer · LS3 · MoTeC M130 · research/2026-09-30_fuel-system-and-regulator.md · every value is sourced there; PROPOSED = agent layout for the builder to confirm at mock-up
A. Plumbing schematic (not to scale). Fuel flows tank → filter → rails → regulator → back to the tank.
31 gal Blazer tank, rear centre, behind the rear axle
Quantum QFS-H882 hanger (owned, in the tank)
check valve built into the pump outlet
(2024-08 line kit: size + side TO CONFIRM)
ENGINE BAY — LS3 top view: REAR (firewall) at left, FRONT at right
(the Y the A1000 instructions name); fit behind the
intake at mock-up, or use the fallback layout (§6)
RAIL L (driver): Holley 534-209, ORB-8 each end, 5/8 in bore
4 × Siemens Deka FI114961, 60 lb/h at 43.5 psi
RAIL R (passenger): Holley 534-209, ORB-8 each end
4 × Siemens Deka FI114961, 60 lb/h at 43.5 psi
fuel pressure sensor in the REG's 1/8 NPT gauge port
vacuum ref hose → a manifold vacuum port on the intake
-6 return from the REG bottom port (Aeromotive 15606 ORB-06→AN-06), along the top of the engine
tee in the -6 return → M130 B6 (AT4)
-6 return on the frame (same rail as the feed)
into the 6AN return on the lid
vent: canister or vent valve — OWNER
Wiring that goes with it (registry wires; gauges from canon ch.16 §1.5)
Pump + #66 14 AWG M22759/32 red PDM15 OUT5 (20 A pair, pigtails A9 + A17), limit 7 A set; load 5.1 A at 60 psi, 4.6 A at 45 psi (Quantum)
Pump − PUMP_GND 14 AWG M22759/32 black in the loom beside #66 to GND-BANK-ENG (grounds in the loom, state §1 row 56)
Pump on/off: the M130 commands the PDM15 output over CAN (MoTeC 'M1 to PDM CAN Messaging' p.8: 'the PDM is essentially acting as a switch')
Fuel PSI #112 signal → M130 A16 (AV3) · #112r 5 V → A02 · #112g 0 V → B16 · 22 AWG M22759/16 · 61-pin cavities y / h / g · plug: AEM 'Packard 3-Pin' (pins in the kit)
Candidate FT: signal → M130 B6 (AT4, spare) + 0 V · 22 AWG M22759/16 · 2 of the 3 spare 61-pin cavities (d, t, u) · sensor not picked
The regulator itself has no wires.
B. Top view in the digital twin's axes (metres): +x driver side (up the page), −y forward (left), frame and exhaust from twin v4
exhaust (twin to y −1.07; the rest unknown)
feed (red) and return (blue) are PROPOSED on the driver rail, beside the pump wires; the side is TO CONFIRM

Sources: Quantum H882 + HFP-367 pages; Aeromotive 13139 page + 13138/13139/13140 instructions; Holley 534-209 page + 199R10582; AEM 10-2131 Rev C; MoTeC GPR datasheet 23072, M1 Flex Fuel guide v1.0, M1-to-PDM guide v1.0; 1977 LTSM p.582; twin v4 (harness-cad). No maker drawing is reproduced.
